public.title: Reading Order II
public.description: input {elements,tolerance}; each element {id,top,left} has distinct id. Sort elements by top, then left, then original index. Build rows greedily: the first remaining element anchors a row, and subsequent sorted elements join while their top minus that anchor top is at most tolerance. Sort each row by left, then top, then original index; return flattened IDs. Tolerance is nonnegative. This fixed top-anchor rule prevents transitive row drift for misaligned canvas boxes. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.

explanation: Sort by top to anchor rows without drift, then sort within each row by horizontal position. O(n log n) time and O(n) space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
